summary_en: Arealink Corporation to launch tender offer for Storage-OH ordinary shares and warrants at ¥1,340/share; minimum 1,291,700 shares (no upper limit disclosed). Offer period July 9–August 21, 2026 (30 business days). Post-acquisition stake 66.67%. Purpose: complete subsidiary acquisition and delisting. Board recommends acceptance.
title_en: Notification of Board Support and Shareholder Recommendation Regarding Tender Offer for Company Shares by Arealink Corporation
translation_en_brief: On 8 July 2026, Storage-OH's board of directors passed a resolution endorsing a tender offer by Arealink Corporation for all ordinary shares and outstanding warrants of Storage-OH, and recommended shareholders and warrant holders to accept the offer. The tender offer runs from 9 July to 21 August 2026 (30 business days). Arealink will offer ¥1,340 per ordinary share. For the two classes of warrants (Series 1 and Series 2), prices are ¥550,000 and ¥350,000 per warrant respectively. The minimum number of shares Arealink will acquire is 1,291,700; no upper limit was disclosed. Upon completion of this acquisition and ancillary procedures, Arealink intends to make Storage-OH a wholly owned subsidiary, and Storage-OH shares are expected to be delisted. Post-acquisition, Arealink's voting stake will be approximately 66.67%. Storage-OH has a pre-existing service relationship with Arealink (Storage-OH is the client, Arealink the service provider for property management). No capital or personnel ties exist between the parties. The board's endorsement and recommendation are premised on the intent to achieve complete subsidiary status and the anticipated delisting.
